newsitem.title: USA: Strong newspaper results boost Gannett Q2.
newsitem.headline: Strong newspaper results boost Gannett Q2.

text.p: Gannett Co Inc said Monday that its newspaper businesses posted record operating profits for the second quarter.

Operating cash flow from newspapers jumped 25 percent, quarter-to-quarter, to $305 million, boosted by strong advertising demand, a 26 percent reduction in newsprint expense, strong performance at its USA Today newspaper, and a favorable comparison at The Detroit News, Gannett said.
The company said that broadcasting cash flow grew 18 percent, quarter-to-quarter, to $111.7 million, on revenues of $189.2 million, a seven percent jump.
The company also said that it expects to close on the acquisition of Army Times Publishing in the third quarter.
Gannett made the comments on the release of second quarter earnings, which totaled $194.7 million, or $1.38 per share, versus $150 million, or $1.07 per share.
The First Call consensus estimates for the quarter called for per share earnings of $1.35.
Gannett publishes 89 daily newspapers and operates 18 television stations, five radio stations, cable television systems and alarm security services.
